title: Elite Baal cult tied to the Epstein material

tellings.quote: because it's apparent that the some of the elite, some of our ruling elite are obsessed with with Bal.

plain: Some of the world's ruling elite are obsessed with Baal, an ancient god of the Middle East, and this shows in the files from the investigations into the wealthy financier Jeffrey Epstein. That is the view of a filmmaker named Tim Alberino, who offers it as his own reading without naming a source. If true, it would mean an old religious cult lives on among the powerful.
